verified: Bloomberg's report says Noeri, a five-month-old startup, raised $110M led by Menlo Ventures for software that reviews clients' AI models and tools; separate reports corroborate the round and identify Stanford professors Carlos Guestrin and Yejin Choi as co-founders, with Nvidia, Snowflake, Cisco, Madrona, Kindred Ventures and NEA also investing.
unconfirmed: Noeri's claimed performance and cost improvements, named customers, independent benchmarks, pricing, and availability; the Bloomberg excerpt itself names neither the founders nor the additional investors.

verified: 据 Bloomberg 记者 Dina Bass 的报道（经 Techmeme 转载），成立五个月、由两位斯坦福人工智能学者共同创办的 Noeri 已完成 1.1 亿美元融资，由 Menlo Ventures 领投；多家二手媒体报道本轮还有 Nvidia、Snowflake、Cisco、Madrona、Kindred Ventures 和 NEA 参与，并称创始人为 Carlos Guestrin 与 Yejin Choi。该公司的产品方向是分析客户的 AI 模型与工具并给出改进建议。
unconfirmed: 本轮融资的估值、除 1.1 亿美元之外是否还有未披露的融资安排，均无来源说明；创始团队所称工具能让较旧模型在性能或成本上取得改善，目前只有公司方面的说法，没有独立评测或基准数据；产品是否已正式发布、如何定价、已有多少客户，原始报道与二手报道都未交代。

titles.en: Noeri raises $110M led by Menlo Ventures for AI model review
titles.zh: Noeri 获 1.1 亿美元融资，Menlo Ventures 领投
